Initial release: Introduces a peak-end-rule-based skill to optimize the client closing experience for real estate agents seeking referrals.

- Focuses on creating memorable "peak" and "end" moments in the transaction to drive referrals.
- Provides guidance on where to invest effort (offer acceptance, keys day, post-close follow-through).
- Includes specific domain inputs and practical examples for solo agents and teams.
- Highlights common pitfalls (front-loaded effort, lack of follow-up).
- Adds verification checklist for effective client experience design.
